findings: [P2][MUST-FIX][Correctness/lifecycle] Retire automatic launch authority after late settlement — src/daemon.rs:724-732. Automatic command/recipe/OMP launches check whether to release their private launch controller only once, when execute_source returns. Integration::execute_inner can return after its five-second acknowledgement deadline with the shell-execute call retained as unknown (src/integration.rs:502-514). If the adapter subsequently reports the exact execution accepted or rejected, Integration::report settles that call, but no consumer revisits launch retirement; the launch thread has already ended and its private recovery credential is unavailable to the user. The PTY consequently remains owned by "automatic launch" even after its unsettled ledger becomes empty, so native acquisition cannot proceed cooperatively and requires force. This violates the Plan's unchanged requirement to retire launch authority once authoritative dispatch settlement arrives. Minimal correction: retain pending automatic-launch retirement state and consume exact late settlement to release/close that launch controller, without replaying startup or releasing while settlement remains unknown. Confidence: 0.96; source-path proof, not an executed reproduction.

A late exact execution-accepted or execution-rejected report then reaches the existing report dispatcher but fails Integration::report's terminal lookup before it can call Authority::settle (src/daemon.rs:1163-1187; src/integration.rs:202-207,234-263). This includes a reporter request already buffered at the daemon when terminal removal wins. Required historical claim inspection therefore retains an unresolved shell call that the actual report consumer can no longer settle; closing claim/controller history cannot reclaim the retired target while that call remains. The new direct-Authority retirement test bypasses this missing production consumer. Minimal correction: retain a settlement-only lookup for unresolved removed-terminal executions, route exact late outcomes through it while rejecting new work/view facts, and reclaim it after settlement. Confidence: 0.93; source-path proof, not an executed reproduction.
